content.headline: Documentation
content.subhead: Everything you need to build with DeclarativeWeb

resources.title: README.md
resources.description: Complete guide covering quick start, features, API reference, LLM usage, and troubleshooting. Start here.

resources.title: BLOCKS.md
resources.description: Reference guide for all content block types: hero, section, markdown, code, html, and component references. Includes examples.

resources.title: schema.json
resources.description: Full JSON Schema validation for site.json structure. Use with VS Code for auto-completion and validation.

resources.title: Site Structure
resources.description: site.json contains: site config, nav, footer, components, functions, and pages. Each page has a path, meta, and content blocks.

resources.title: Content Blocks
resources.description: Eight block types: hero (headers), section (cards), markdown (text), code (snippets), html (custom), mermaid (diagrams), frappe-chart (data viz), and $ref (components).

resources.title: Navigation Layouts
resources.description: Three layouts: horizontal (top bar), vertical (sidebar), or both (sidebar + top actions). Set via nav.layout property.

resources.title: Expression Syntax
resources.description: Use double curly braces for dynamic values. Access state, do math, comparisons, ternary operators. Safe evaluation without eval().

resources.title: Conditional Rendering
resources.description: Use if/then/else to show different content based on state. Nested conditionals supported.

resources.title: State Management
resources.description: Reactive state with Render.state. Changes trigger automatic re-renders. Deep object/array support.

resources.title: Composable JSON with $import
resources.description: Split large site.json files into separate page files. Pages are lazy-loaded on navigation with HTTP caching. Use $import property for external JSON references.

resources.title: Theme Customization
resources.description: Customize fontSize (50-200%), primaryColor, secondaryColor, and fontFamily in site.theme.

resources.title: Error Handling
resources.description: Inline error cards for malformed blocks. Helpful messages without breaking the page. Check console for details.
